def factor_volume_regime_weighted_avg_return(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    ret_daily = close.pct_change()
    avg_ret_20 = ret_daily.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=20)
    signal = avg_ret_20 * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_volume_regime_weighted_avg_return"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_volume_regime_weighted_avg_return"]
description: Replaces the point-to-point 20-day return with the average daily return over a 20-day window, preserving the parent's volume-weighted trend-following mechanism but reducing sensitivity to endpoint prices. The volume intensity from classify_volume_regime still amplifies the trend signal in high-volume regimes. This mutation aims to improve IC by smoothing the trend component while retaining the RankIC stability of the parent.
